title: Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope
description: A turn-based tactical adventure where Mario, Rabbids and new heroes travel across a galaxy threatened by Cursa. Movement is free inside combat zones, Sparks provide elemental and tactical powers, and three major DLC adventures extend the campaign.

tagline: Build a three-hero squad, combine Sparks and save a galaxy corrupted by Cursa.
fitFor: Players who enjoy accessible turn-based tactics
Mario/Rabbids fans who want a longer adventure
Players who like exploration between tactical battles
notFitFor: Players sensitive to a fixed 30 fps target

contents.label: Nine playable heroes and customizable three-character squads

gameplayPillars.title: Free-movement tactics
gameplayPillars.description: Heroes move freely inside a limited combat area before spending actions, replacing the predecessor's grid movement.

gameplayPillars.title: Sparks and team building
gameplayPillars.description: Equip Sparks to change elemental damage, movement, defense and tactical roles across a nine-hero roster.

gameplayPillars.title: Planet exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Leave combat to solve puzzles, find side quests, collect Sparks and uncover optional challenges.

worldSummary: The heroes travel between distinct planets such as Beacon Beach, Pristine Peaks and Palette Prime. Each mixes explorable hubs, side quests, puzzles and tactical battle arenas while Cursa's Darkmess corrupts the galaxy.

storyChapters.title: Cursa's threat
storyChapters.body: A cosmic entity spreads Darkmess and hunts the Sparks.

storyChapters.title: Planet-hopping resistance
storyChapters.body: Mario, Rabbid Peach, Edge and allies travel across multiple worlds to rescue Sparks and defeat Darkmess Tentacles.

storyChapters.title: Final confrontation
storyChapters.body: The growing team pushes toward Cursa while revealing the connection between Rosalina, the Sparks and the galactic threat.

features: Nine playable heroes and customizable three-character squads

perfNotes: Technical analysis measures 1600×900 docked and about 1066×600 handheld with a 30 fps target. On Switch 2 the game remains capped at 30 fps, with improved consistency/loading but no native Switch 2 upgrade.

faq.a: No. Sparks of Hope is a single-player tactical adventure.

faq.q: How does it perform on Switch 2?
faq.a: It remains capped at 30 fps and keeps the Switch rendering profile, with better consistency/loading but no native Switch 2 upgrade.

faq.q: How many major DLC packs are there?
faq.a: There are three major DLC adventures: The Tower of Doooom, The Last Spark Hunter and Rayman in the Phantom Show.

verdictSummary: A smart tactical sequel that loosens grid restrictions, expands exploration and creates far more flexible team builds through Sparks.
verdictPros: Strong audiovisual personality and DLC support
verdictCons: Occasional performance drops on original Switch

reviews.quote: Generally favorable to very strong critical reception.
